name: Scite
tagline: Search scientific papers and see how they cite each other
description: Scite is an AI-powered platform that helps researchers discover and evaluate scientific literature, using Smart Citations to show whether studies support or contradict a claim.
features: Assistant and search across scientific literature
Smart Citations showing whether studies support or contradict a claim
Paper collections (up to 1,000 on Basic, 10,000 on Pro)
API access and MCP credits on paid plans
useCases: Checking how a paper has been cited
Finding supporting or contradicting evidence for a claim
strengths: Citation context rather than just citation counts
A 7-day free trial on Basic and Pro
limitations: No free plan was stated on the pricing page
Prices are shown billed yearly; the monthly-billing price is not stated

pricing.trial: Basic and Pro list a 7-day free trial that lets you explore all premium features without commitment.

plans.name: Basic
plans.billing: $12 per month, billed yearly (the page shows a $96 saving)

plans.name: Pro
plans.billing: $40 per month, billed yearly (the page shows a $120 saving)
highlights: API access, including a $60 API credit shown as limited time

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Custom pricing based on users and usage; collections up to 50,000 papers and unlimited users with pooled usage

pricing.regional: Prices were shown with a '$' sign. Tax and regional pricing: not stated.

verification.notes: Product active. Basic $12/month and Pro $40/month, both billed yearly (save $96 and $120), each with a 7-day free trial; Pro adds API access and larger collections (10,000 papers); Enterprise custom. The monthly-billing price is not shown.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

profile.headline: Research search that shows whether later studies support or contradict a paper

capabilities.title: Search full text, not only abstracts
capabilities.text: Search across 300M+ articles, preprints, books, patents and datasets.

capabilities.title: See how research was cited
capabilities.text: Smart Citations show whether later work supports, challenges or merely mentions a paper, claim, method, journal, author, institution or funder.

capabilities.title: Ask a question and get a cited answer
capabilities.text: AssistantAI answers from the literature, and every claim links to the specific sentence in the specific paper.

capabilities.title: Organise and monitor papers
capabilities.text: Collections track the papers you care about.

featureCards.name: AssistantAI
featureCards.text: An AI assistant grounded in research.

featureCards.name: Browser extension
featureCards.text: Shows citation badges on pages you visit.

featureCards.name: MCP
featureCards.text: Connects AI agents such as Claude and ChatGPT to scite.

featureCards.name: API and Holdings
featureCards.text: Programmatic data access, and full-text access through your library.

audienceDetail.text: The site cites over two million users.
Named alongside researchers and industry experts.

scenarios.title: Trace an idea to its application
